lead: Pin, city as the heading, the address on its own lines and a directions link. One to twelve entries at two, three or four across.
note: Each directions link names its own destination: twelve cards all offering 'Directions' give a screen-reader user twelve identical links and no way to tell them apart.

items.title: The title is the city
items.text:
The text holds the address
and keeps its line breaks
so it can be copied

items.title: Each card is an address element
items.text:
Street and number
Postcode and town
Phone

items.title: Cards end level
items.text:
Every card stretches to the tallest
of its row, which is what keeps
the pins on one line
